description: Defines the CRLSet class for managing Certificate Revocation List (CRL) data, including parsing, checking revocations, and testing utilities within the net namespace.

classes.name: CRLSet
classes.description: Represents a set of revoked certificates and related CRL data, with methods for parsing, checking revocations, and testing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses CRL data bytes into a CRLSet object.

methods.name: CheckSPKI
methods.description: Checks if a given SPKI hash is listed as revoked.

methods.name: CheckSerial
methods.description: Checks if a serial number associated with an issuer SPKI hash is revoked.

methods.name: CheckSubject
methods.description: Checks if a subject name and SPKI hash are revoked.

methods.name: IsKnownInterceptionKey
methods.description: Determines if a given SPKI hash is used for interception.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the CRLSet has expired based on current time.

methods.name: sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the CRLSet.

methods.name: CrlsForTesting
methods.description: Returns internal CRL list for testing.

methods.name: EmptyCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an empty CRLSet for unit testing.

methods.name: ExpiredCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an expired CRLSet for testing.

methods.name: ForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CRLSet configured for testing with specific parameters.
